text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with good conduct, good health, and a high school diploma or equivalent from a full-time Chinese high school or above, holding a valid foreign passport, and meeting the relevant regulations stipulated in the "Notice on Regulating the Admission of International Students by Chinese Higher Education Institutions" (Jiaowai Han [2020] No. 12) issued by the Ministry of Education. 2. Generally, the age should be between 18 and 30 years old. 3. Good academic performance in subjects such as mathematics, physics, chemistry and biology, meeting the admission requirements (exempt from written test).
